## Custom Engineering Services
- Starter Audit & Workflow Fix ($65 fixed, 48h turnaround): Debug 1 broken n8n/Zapier webhook, single API sync, or Notion formula fix.
- Full Custom System Setup ($175 fixed, 3-5 days): Custom Notion Business OS / CRM, multi-step n8n + AI workflow, or Next.js Vercel landing page.
- Ongoing Automation Partner ($350/mo): Continuous workflow monitoring, up to 4 new n8n/Notion builds per month, rate-limit optimization.
